scope: H15 explicit permanent removal of an owned retained linked worktree after independent verified recovery material and a separate confirmation; explicit recovery into a fresh independent ordinary repository.
productionBoundaries: Official Git is invoked only on exact locally verified roots. No Agent call/configuration, original user data, formal application or real project repository was operated by this implementation task. Tests use dedicated temporary repositories.

remove_inspect -> remove_prepare builds a durable non-cache bundle and manifest, then stops at awaitingConfirmation while the actual maintenance owner holds admission and the draft write seal. Only the separate six-field worktree_remove_confirm can authorize deletion. Old worktree_start rejects removal; repeated confirmations must match the same tuple.

HEAD, supported private refs and independently enumerated private reflogs (including orphaned logs and old/new commit roots), ORIG_HEAD and FETCH_HEAD are captured with exact raw evidence digests. Unknown/private in-progress layouts reject. Metadata or reflog changes with the same deduplicated root set still invalidate the proof.

Fixed roots are packed without source refs/index/config changes, imported into a fresh bare repository, checked for exact object closure and fsck, bundled, then actually restored into a second independent repository with all recovery refs and physical content verification. No source object alternates or remote are installed in the recovery repository.

Content comparison is separate from inode material identity and includes checkout bytes, file type, Git executable bits, link targets and empty-directory presence. Physical dirty data, ignored/untracked files and assume-unchanged edits prevent deletion when not reproduced by the exact checkout. This is not an ACL/xattr/system backup.

The selected parent and the originally reserved recovery-directory stamp are checked before and after work. A nonempty recovery directory rejects. Git writes only a private staged bundle; final publication uses bounded 64KiB streaming, create_new, O_NOFOLLOW, digest/size checks and fsync. An existing final file or symlink is never intentionally replaced.

Deletion uses official git worktree remove without force and never deletes branches or rewrites history/cwd. Current recovery/source/roots/content/directory identity are rechecked before dispatch; dispatch is persisted before Git invocation. Ready requires verified absence of exact original/retained/private Git paths, registration removal, original parent and retained-parent identity, and unchanged branch target.

Recover selects an exact canonical parent and new directory name, uses verified immutable recovery data, checks the actual independent repo/refs/HEAD/content and reports ownership existing, never created linked. Recovery remains possible with source objects unavailable. Result is not automatically used or sent to an Agent.

One durable current intent, bounded location/archive/material/recovery metadata and strict version migration are maintained; no operation event ledger. Recovery records remain reachable after later intents. Cold reload marks current claims unknown, clears current removed receipts and never restarts work. Only explicit actual rechecking regenerates ready.

Cancellation and lost replies retain exact request identity and worker-held admission until actual work finishes. Roots type-verification observes cancellation before every Git read. Panic/child ownership follows the existing reaping guard. Cold settled indicates this instance has no worker, not proof that a prior process stopped.
